description: Ground-truth labels for measuring precision/recall of corpus-reduction rules. See ground-truth-spec.md in this directory for the full population protocol, label definitions, stratified sampling plan, and PII-redaction guidance. Each entry in `labels` must be an object with the following fields: { source_msg_id: string, source: string, text_snippet: string (PII-redacted, max 200 chars), label: 'high_value' | 'low_value' | 'noise' | 'redundant' | 'broken', labeled_at: ISO-8601 string, labeler_notes: string | null }.
